path_instructions.instructions:
Review the changed paths on two separate axes.
Read the discipline as a file (do not invoke it as a Skill tool):
/home/andre/.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md
Standards axis: the repository's documented standards (CONTRIBUTING.md and the files it points to).
Where the repository is silent, fall back to the skill's code-smell baseline as a judgement call only, never a hard violation; a documented repo standard always overrides the baseline.
Spec axis: faithful implementation of this run's intent - missing or partial requirements, scope creep, and requirements that look implemented but wrong.
Keep the two axes separate: prefix each finding description with its axis, Standards: or Spec:, and never merge or rerank findings across axes.
Review behaviour, severity handling, and finding format are otherwise unchanged.
